title: Wɔn a Wɔpam Wɔn Fi Turo no Mu
intro: Bere bi na ahintasɛm abɔde bi te abɔde mu dibea a ɛkorɔn sen biara mu, na na ɔbɛn Ɔsoro no sen sɛnea nnipa pii betumi asusuw ho. Nanso ahantan gyee ntini, na adeyɛ biako pɛ a wɔyɛe sɛ wɔsɔre tia no sesaa asetra kwan. Afei, saa abɔde yi kyinkyin sɛ ɔtamfo a waka ntam, ɔrebɔ nkɔmmɔ na ɔbɔ pɔw kosi sɛ da bi a wɔahyɛ ho bɔ bɛba. So wubetumi ahu onii ko a nea wahwe ase yi yɛ?
clues: Bere bi na meka wɔn a wɔbɛn Ɔsoro baabi a wɔwɔ no ho, a wɔama me so asen abɔde dodow no ara.
Wɔde biribi a ɛhyew na ɛbɔɔ me, na ɛnyɛ asase anaa dɔte.
Bere a wɔhyɛɛ me sɛ menkotow abɔde foforo anim no, mepowee — a nea migye di sɛ ɛyɛ m’ankasa me korɔn na ɛkanyan me.
Wɔtow me fii hɔ na wɔdomee me, nanso awiei koraa no wɔmaa me bere a wɔde bɛma no kosii sɛ bere a wonim, a wɔahyɛ ato hɔ.
Mekaa ntam sɛ mɛdaadaa nnipa dodow biara a metumi, na mafi baabiara abɛn Adam asefo.
Me ne adesamma nyinaa tamfo a wɔabue ne ho, a wɔapae mu aka, a mebɔ pɔw na mebɔ nkɔmmɔ bere nyinaa kosi awiei a wɔahyɛ no.

trial.label: Asɔhwɛ / Adeyɛ
options: Pow a wɔpow sɛ wɔbɛkotow Adam anim
Sika nantwi ba a wɔresi ama nkurɔfo no asom
Po no a wɔde poma bɛpaapae mu
Ɔsoa Seba Hemmaa ahengua no prɛko pɛ
trial.answer: Pow a wɔpow sɛ wɔbɛkotow Adam anim

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Ahomegye a wɔde ma kosi Atemmu Da no
Wɔmenee wɔn wɔ po mu ne asraafo dɔm
Wosiee no nkwa mu wɔ ahemfie bi a ɛrebubu ase
Wɔmaa no so kɔɔ dibea a ɛkorɔn
outcome.answer: Ahomegye a wɔde ma kosi Atemmu Da no

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verse: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all (15:39)
